name: motion-primitives
title: Motion Primitives
responsibility: Ready-made React animation primitives (text effects, in-view, cursor, dock, morphing, …) built on motion. The default animation source — simple stays simple.

upstream.notice: MIT (c) 2024 ibelick. components/core snapshotted from main into components-core/; hooks into hooks/. repo-tree.json = GitHub API tree for locating docs examples (app/docs/). Their live registry (https://motion-primitives.com/r/<name>.json) sits behind a Vercel bot check for scripts — use this GitHub snapshot.

localChanges: Snapshot carries our deliberate local craft variants (same policy as handcraft tokenization): type-only imports (verbatimModuleSyntax), React.ElementType instead of JSX.IntrinsicElements, hardcoded hex replaced by hsl(var(--token)) (text-shimmer, glow-effect), InView extended with delay/className props and a prefers-reduced-motion gate. Presets vendoring these files keep a provenance header naming this snapshot as the source of truth — never re-vendor raw upstream over them.
reachFor: Reusable entrance/in-view animations, text effects, hover/pointer effects
Morphing dialogs/popovers, docks, spotlights — polished primitives
The FIRST stop before reaching for GSAP (principle: simple animation stays simple)
avoid: Complex scrubbed timelines / physics — hand off to GSAP / React Spring
inRepo: consumed by create-preset.py --mp/--hooks; vendored copies live in every preset under src/components/primitives/ with provenance headers
